SELECT AVG(y."Consumption") AS monthly_avg_consumption
FROM main."yearmonth" y
JOIN main."customers" c ON y."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"
WHERE c."Currency" = 'CZK'
  AND y."Date" = '201308'
